button.class: btn btn-link btn-sm p-0 text-primary border-0
button.title: Subject Notifications

ul.style: min-width: 400px; max-width: 520px; max-height: 560px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0.75rem; z-index: 1060;

div.div: No teacher assigned for this subject.

div.class: card-header bg-primary text-white d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center

a.class: list-group-item list-group-item-action d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start lms-open-item

t.p: No documents, videos or updates yet.

t.t-if: m.material_type == 'video' and m.url and not m.attachment_id

div.class: d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3

a.t-attf-href: /school/lms/calendar?month=#{month == 1 and 12 or month - 1}&year=#{month == 1 and year - 1 or year}
/school/lms/calendar?month=#{month == 12 and 1 or month + 1}&year=#{month == 12 and year + 1 or year}

td.t-attf-class: calendar-day p-2 align-top small #{'table-primary' if cell.get('is_today') else ''} #{'has-event' if cell.get('events') else ''}

div.p: Your issue has been submitted. We will fix it soon.

textarea.name: description
textarea.placeholder: Describe your issue (e.g. lesson not loading, doubt in topic, etc.)

span.t-attf-class: badge bg-#{'success' if issue.state == 'done' else 'warning' if issue.state == 'in_progress' else 'info'}

div.p: Forgot password? Request a reset link by email.
